title: Add omission prevention gate

phases.label: Web-first intake
phases.bottleneck_notes: Official checklist and traceability sources were checked before local implementation.

phases.label: Memory bootstrap
phases.bottleneck_notes: Existing bootstrap manifest was already available and later rechecked after updates.

phases.label: Requirements and specs
phases.bottleneck_notes: New durable requirement, review, change records, and bilingual spec artifacts were created.

phases.label: Implementation and docs
phases.bottleneck_notes: Most time went into threading the new target through evaluator, CLI, registry, memory anchors, policies, prompts, and navigation.

phases.label: Verification
phases.bottleneck_notes: Unit tests and config checks were run, then follow-up docs and generated maps needed validation.

phases.label: Evaluation
phases.bottleneck_notes: Omission coverage, grounding, and work evaluation had to be created after implementation.

phases.label: Commit and push
phases.bottleneck_notes: Final git commit and push were expected to be short after verification; actual remote push status is checked separately.

bottleneck_notes: Implementation and documentation fan-out is the slowest measured phase.
Future improvement: generate evaluator-target propagation patches from a small schema to reduce manual updates.
